moves.title: A weekly Reel from the audio briefing
moves.why: You said go and asked for quips, so it's rebuilt: one quick line a story over its artwork, in the briefing's voice. The No. 17 cut is below.
moves.plan: Rebuilt Tue Oct 13 as a quip a story (the No. 17 cut is above). The first one goes out Wed Oct 14 at 1 PM with No. 18 unless you say don't.

moves.title: Tag the artist in the picture too
moves.why: You asked for it and the numbers agree: the four posts over a hundred were the ones where somebody with their own crowd was tagged.
moves.plan: From Wed Oct 14 every handle a story names (the venue, the band, the organizer) is tagged in the image, not only the venue. Say don't and it is the venue alone.
